name: Cape International, runway 18/36
summary: The crossing runway of the island's airliner airport, down the flat east shore of the north-east cape. Landed on northward (36) from its southern threshold: a final into 18 would begin 21.7 km out, past the world's edge. It crosses runway 09/27 2,850 m from 36's threshold.

sources.length_m: As runway 09/27's: the 747-400 at its maximum weight on a hot day, Boeing D6-58326-1 rev F 3.3.4, rounded up to 3,500 m.
sources.width_m: FAA AC 150/5300-13B change 1, table G-11: 150 ft.
sources.place: Moved 200 m east of first sketch (x 5,900) so the final into 36 keeps 600 m either side clear of the mountain ring's east flank under its glide path. The island's east band, x 6,100 and beyond, is clear of rock from z -7,100 to +1,900 (lane/airport's rock map, 2026-09-19), so the final into 36 comes up the shore from the south over flat ground.
sources.pattern: The sea side at each end (AIM 4-3-3 b): landing north on 36 the sea is to the right, landing south on 18 it is to the left.
